name: loss_making_negative_irr
derivation: Loss-making project: invest 1,000,000 agorot at t=0, recover only 900,000 at t=1.
Root policy check: the only root is negative and inside (-0.99, 10) => it is returned
(honest IRR of a losing deal), not clamped to 0 like the audited prototype solver (D-4).
Payback: cumulative -1,000,000 then -100,000, never reaches 0 => null.
